name: General Translation
settings.subtitle: Choose what to translate and how translations reach your readers.
settings.projectHint: Use the project that matches your source locale. Save settings before testing the connection.
settings.keyHelp: Set GT_API_KEY on the Strapi server, then restart it. The key stays on the server and cannot be edited here.
settings.mappingHint: Map each Strapi locale to a supported GT locale. Strapi locale codes stay unchanged.
settings.fieldsHint: Localized text is selected by default. Numbers, relations and shared media files are kept. Nested fields use their parent selection and context.
settings.noTypes: No localized content types are available. Enable internationalization on a content type to configure its fields.
settings.contextHint: Optional instructions to help GT understand this field.
settings.media: Translate media alt text and captions for {model}
settings.mediaHint: Localized metadata is stored per document and locale. Edit it in the translation panel. The Media Library still edits shared metadata. Published REST reads include valid localized metadata.
settings.deliveryHint: Translations remain drafts when Draft and Publish is enabled, unless automatic publishing is selected. Content without Draft and Publish is visible immediately. Content and locale permissions still apply.
settings.autoHint: Automatic translation is off by default. It uses the configured targets and requires an authorized editor.
translation.title: Translate content
translation.source: Translates saved {locale} content into the selected locales.
translation.count: {count, plural, one {# document selected} other {# documents selected}}
translation.consent: I reviewed the target content and accept replacing human edits
translation.noTargets: No target locales are configured. Ask an administrator to choose target locales in General Translation settings.
translation.unsaved: Save this document before translating it. Unsaved changes are not sent to GT.
translation.notConfigured: Ask an administrator to configure General Translation before translating.
translation.draft: New translations will be saved as drafts for review.
translation.published: Translations will be published automatically when your permissions allow it.
translation.immediate: This content type does not use Draft and Publish. Saved translations are visible immediately.
translation.create: Missing target locales can be created when your permissions allow it.
translation.keepMissing: Create missing target locales in Content Manager before translating.
translation.cost: Translation uses your organization's GT account. Force retranslation may incur new charges.
jobs.title: Job history
jobs.subtitle: Review translation progress, resulting locales and actionable failures.
jobs.empty: No translation jobs yet. Translate a saved document to create the first job.
media.title: Localized media metadata
media.help: These changes belong only to this document and locale. The Media Library changes shared source metadata.
media.draft: Edits are saved to the locale's draft and appear after publishing it.
media.published: Published metadata is read only. Switch to the draft tab to edit it.
media.immediate: This content type does not use Draft and Publish. Metadata edits are visible immediately.
media.empty: No eligible media metadata is available. Enable media metadata in settings and save media on this locale.
media.label: Localized {property}: {path}
media.nullHint: An empty string is kept as an intentional empty value. Reset restores shared source metadata.
media.caption: caption
jobs.retryConsent: I checked GT and accept retrying job {id}
diagnostic.invalid-key.fix: Set a valid GT_API_KEY on the Strapi server and restart it
diagnostic.invalid-key.fallback: Continue editing while an administrator updates the key
diagnostic.missing-key.happened: The GT connection is not configured
diagnostic.missing-key.fix: Set GT_API_KEY on the Strapi server and restart it
diagnostic.quota-exhausted.happened: GT paused translation because the account has no available credit
diagnostic.quota-exhausted.fix: Review billing and spending limits in your GT account
diagnostic.quota-exhausted.fallback: Keep the existing translations until credit is available
diagnostic.permission-denied.happened: You do not have permission to translate this content
diagnostic.permission-denied.fix: Ask an administrator for the required content and locale permissions
diagnostic.human-edit.happened: A target field was edited after translation
diagnostic.human-edit.fix: Review the target content before choosing force retranslate
diagnostic.stale-source.happened: The source changed while translation was running
diagnostic.stale-source.fallback: The target content has been kept
diagnostic.ai-conflict.happened: Strapi AI Translations is also enabled
diagnostic.ai-conflict.why: Both translation systems can update the same locales
diagnostic.ai-conflict.fix: Choose one automatic translator for these content types
diagnostic.admin-request-failure.happene: The translation screen could not complete the request
diagnostic.admin-request-failure.fix: Retry the request after checking your connection
diagnostic.admin-request-failure.fallbac: Keep editing the document and try again later
diagnostic.admin-incompatible.happened: The required Content Manager extension is unavailable
diagnostic.admin-incompatible.fix: Use the Strapi version supported by this plugin and rebuild the admin panel
diagnostic.force-retranslate.happened: Force retranslate can replace human edits in the selected locales
diagnostic.force-retranslate.fix: Review the target content before continuing
diagnostic.force-retranslate.fallback: Keep the existing translations by cancelling
diagnostic.interrupted-request.happened: The translation request ended before its result was saved
diagnostic.interrupted-request.why: GT may already have accepted and billed this request
diagnostic.interrupted-request.fix: Check the job in GT before retrying
diagnostic.interrupted-request.fallback: Keep the current content while you review the request
diagnostic.media-unavailable.happened: Localized media text could not be loaded
diagnostic.media-unavailable.fix: Review the translation job and saved media metadata
diagnostic.media-unavailable.fallback: The shared media text is shown
diagnostic.unsupported-locale.happened: The locale is not supported by GT
diagnostic.unsupported-locale.fix: Select a supported locale or add an explicit locale mapping
diagnostic.network-failure.happened: The GT request could not finish
diagnostic.network-failure.fix: Check the server network connection and retry the job
diagnostic.validation.happened: The translation request is not valid
diagnostic.validation.fix: Correct the highlighted settings and try again
diagnostic.provider-failure.happened: GT could not translate the content
diagnostic.provider-failure.fix: Review the job details and retry after correcting the cause
diagnostic.missing-locale.happened: The target locale does not exist for this document
diagnostic.missing-locale.fix: Enable creation of missing locales and confirm your create permission
diagnostic.source-locale-mismatch.happen: The GT project uses a different source locale
diagnostic.source-locale-mismatch.fix: Select the matching GT project before uploading translation files
